message.content: {"code":"function chooseBin(item, remainingCapacities){let best=-1,worst=-1;const n=remainingCapacities.length;if(n===0)return-1;const t=item+n+1;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const r=remainingCapacities[i];if(r>=item&&(best===-1||r<remainingCapacities[best]))best=i;if(worst===-1||r<remainingCapacities[worst])worst=i;}if(best!==-1&&remainingCapacities[best]<t)return best;if(worst!==-1&&remainingCapacities[worst]>=item)return worst;return best;}","hypothesis":"Open a new bin only when even the emptiest existing bin would need more added slack than item+n+1 to outperform Best-Fit."}
